name: Offshore North
tagline: Ocean racing, from a Canadian dock.
description: Offshore North is the Nerra Network's weekly guide to offshore ocean racing. One of the great endurance sports on earth is reported almost entirely in French, which leaves English-speaking fans with the results but not the meaning. Every Monday, Dan closes that gap: what Canada Ocean Racing did on the road to the Vendée Globe and what it actually changes, the week in the wider IMOCA fleet — races, new boats, rule changes, and the money behind all of it — and Plain Sailing, one concept explained properly for people who love this sport without living inside it. Sources named in every episode and linked in the notes. No hype, no play-by-play, and nothing stated that the sources do not support.
